input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer; § 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and disclaims any exclusivity commitment, which meets the preferred position. A full-text search for exclusivity language returned only exclusivity that runs in our favour or is unrelated (non-exclusive licence grant in § 13.1, IP ownership, exclusive remedy/jurisdiction wording). The § 7.2 disclose-and-match right and the § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum operate as commercial friction rather than an exclusive-dealing covenant, and are addressed under the MFN and minimum-commitment rules — we do not double-flag them here.
